plan_warnings: The tunnel (S12 to S14, 27 s) is the main risk: it must be dark in mood but coloured and readable. Build riverTunnel and the lantern mask first and review stills before any acting.
The duck pose is new and happens fast (85.0 to 86.9); check every second frame.
The lid point of view is the only first person shot in the series; if it reads badly, fall back to a close shot of his face with the lids opening and the faces reflected in his eyes.
Six people on the beach plus raft building in S9 and S10: keep the helpers' actions simple and staggered so the main action stays readable.
The story balloon in S20 carries a narrated event at half scale (figures about 115 px on screen); keep it uncluttered: five figures, a donkey, the ship.
Seven short pauses only; effects are 8 and brief. No effect on the impact frame.
Three new sets plus the raft make four major new assets; all four are reusable, and the cove and tunnel reuse SIND-01 and SIND-02 code.
